task_name: World 121 Task B  -  Day-1 Reversals of Prior-Period Controlled Estimates, Unbilled CRO Accrual & Close Status Classification
prompt: Review the Chart of Accounts, controlled-estimate journal log, payroll and vendor bill settlements, and close governance policy in aether_diagnostics_oct2026_close_sources.xlsx. Distinguish prior-period Day-1 estimate reversals from current-month unbilled accrual exposure, reconcile the October R&D payroll, lab reagent consumables, and clinical CRO expense accounts including any prior-estimate true-up variance from raw service dates, and state the governed October close status and true-up deadline.

rubric.description: Identifies JE-2026-1001A (-$12,400.00 reversing JE-2026-0930A) and JE-2026-1001B (-$6,850.00 reversing JE-2026-0930B) as $19,250.00 gross prior-period estimate reversals.
Refuses to include the $19,250.00 gross 2026-10-01 reversals as new 2026-10 estimated expense exposure, preventing a $28,650.00 overstated estimate register.
Isolates actual 2026-10 controlled-estimate exposure as $9,400.00 solely from unbilled CRO accrual JE-2026-1031C (debit to 6240 and credit to 2110, reversing 2026-11-01).
Computes the +$270.00 prior-estimate true-up delta on PO-771 between BILL-5012 ($7,120.00) and JE-2026-1001B (-$6,850.00) without netting unrelated P&L accounts.
Reconciles 2026-10 lab consumables expense in 5210 across JE-2026-1001B (-$6,850.00), BILL-5012 ($7,120.00), and BILL-5048 ($14,300.00) to $14,570.00.
Classifies the 2026-10 close state as closed with estimates with a 2026-11-30 true-up deadline rather than certified.
Refuses to certify the 2026-10 books as finalized with no open items while unbilled CRO estimate JE-2026-1031C ($9,400.00) and missing-statement account 1030 remain open for true-up.
